explanation.headline: Milrinone lactate is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; supply traces to a plant with VAI inspections in 2015, 2018, and 2023

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include milrinone lactate as of 2026-10-21.
The product used at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside carries NDC 71288020011 and is labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc.
That NDC maps to a registered plant, Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (FEI 3010625707) in China.
FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2015-05-12, 2018-04-03, and 2023-11-10.
No FDA regulatory action such as an import alert or warning letter is documented for this plant in the provided records.
Corvale General holds 158 vials (26.3 days on hand) and Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials (8 days on hand) of the 1 mg/mL, 10 mL presentation.
The rule-based recommendation is to transfer 10 vials from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, which would leave the sender with about 25 days and bring the receiver to about 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
